summary: Iran's acting defense minister warns of confrontation over any agreement violation and accuses the U.S. of prolonging the Zionist entity, while Israel's defense minister unilaterally announces the dismissal of Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Blot without chief of staff coordination, prompting a freeze on all major general appointments until 2027. Simultaneously, Trump says a massive planned strike on Iran was cancelled and negotiations on the Strait of Hormuz begin Monday, though Iran denies direct talks with Washington.
key_points: Iran's acting defense minister Brig. Gen. Majid bin al-Rida states armed forces will confront any violation of the agreement, warns of Israeli plans for security zones in Syria and Lebanon, and says U.S. statements on a new front against Hezbollah risk regional security. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382680)

Israeli Defense Minister Katz announces dismissal of Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Blot and appointment of Maj. Gen. Dado Bar Kalifa without Chief of Staff Zamir's knowledge; Zamir responds by freezing all major general appointments until early 2027. (Source: @inon_yttach/9791, @yediotnews25/133517, @yediotnews25/133528)

Trump says a massive attack on Iran, the largest since WWII, was cancelled after counterparts asked him not to proceed; negotiations on Strait of Hormuz and nuclear file to start Monday; Iran denies negotiations with U.S., says talks only with Oman on safe passage. (Source: @mamlekate/104063, @shin_persian/8790, @rasedal3ado138e/382672)

Israeli Air Force strikes Ali Taher ridge in Lebanon; hostile drone violates Beirut southern suburb airspace; IDF artillery fire reported at Ramim Ridge. (Source: @New_security8200/203157, @lelotsenzura/94037, @rasedal3ado138e/382683, @N12chat/220403)

IDF eliminates senior Hamas military operative in Gaza City; Israeli Navy exercise conducted between Shavei Zion and Ashdod; military exercise in Ra'anana with lighting and troop movements. (Source: @inon_yttach/9786, @idf_telegram/24812, @New_security8200/203158)

Explosion at Camp Taji ammunition depot in Baghdad; explosion at Baiji refinery hydrogen unit in Salahuddin due to technical fault; jet activity over Najaf; Iraqi Kurdistan President Barzani to meet Jolani in Damascus. Gulf states frustrated with U.S. strategy, request more interceptors and security guarantees; CENTCOM rotates F-35A jets via RAF Mildenhall; Israeli SIGINT aircraft (Nachshon Shavit) and U.S. MLAT aircraft operate over Palestine. points: Acting Defense Minister Brig. Gen. Majid bin al-Rida states Iran signed the agreement to help restore regional stability but does not trust the other party; armed forces will confront any violation with a proportional response; U.S. support prolongs the Zionist entity and Islamic countries must prevent its tension-escalating policies. Foreign Ministry spokesman Baqaei says there are no negotiations with the U.S. currently; talks are only between two coastal states (Iran and Oman) regarding safe passage for ships through the Strait of Hormuz; the strait was not closed due to a dispute with Oman but due to U.S. aggression. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382672)

Trump states a planned massive attack on Iran, the largest since WWII, was cancelled after counterparts asked him not to proceed; negotiations on Strait of Hormuz and nuclear file to begin Monday afternoon Washington time; Iran denies direct talks with U.S. (Source: @mamlekate/104063, @shin_persian/8790, @rodast_omiddana/78608)

CENTCOM swaps F-35A jets via RAF Mildenhall: two F-35As deployed July 31 (TABOR71 19-5474, TABOR72 22-5682) and two returned August 3 (TABOR81 15-5200, TABOR82 17-5237), supported by KC-135 tankers. (Source: @shin_persian/8794)
